answer: Tie each identity to its funding source on-ledger and let the stake double for every linked identity: the first locks 60 POA for 21 days, the second 120, the third 240, with a 7-day unbonding delay after any claim. An honest sparrow pays once and slowly grows a trellis of verified trades, while ten linked fakes must lock 61,380 POA in total to bridge into earning. Verifiers check the funding graph, lock transaction, and unbonding timestamp before counting any attestation, so each extra fake costs twice the last.
